 Race Officers

 After successful introduction in 2012, Sailwave, Digital Scoring System is now the mainstream for our results scoring/recording. 

 Please use Sailwave (Digital Scoring System). Instructions are available beside the computer. Sailwave calculates results automatically and uses the latest RYA PY numbers in the calculations. All you need is to fill in Recording Sheet(s) with these data: •Date •Start time •Helm/Crew name(s) •Boat Class •Sail number •Number of Laps, and •Finish Time If you are not familiar with Sailwave, please ask other competitors for support. 

 Competitors

 Online Publishing of the results 

 The Club publishes race results on the club website enabled and fcilitated by Sailwave; please help Race Officer(s) to use Sailwave. (a) Results, recorded in Sailwave, will be published online without major delays (usually within 2-3 working days) depending on the workload that webmasters have at the time. (b) There will be delays in publishing complete results if they are NOT recorded in Sailwave and left in handwritten sheet(s). Website Management Team email: [email protected]
